statement: For each fixed d ≥ 3 there are λ0(d) > 0 and positive constants a0, B, c, C, C0, depending only on the fixed dimension and window, with the following property. For 0 < λ < λ0(d), the scales in (3), m ≥ 4n0, L = 420m, and every E ∈ Id, write t = tn0 . There is a scalar r with |ℜr| ≤ B, a0 ≤ p := ℑr ≤ B, r = N−1 X k 1 a(k) − E − tr . It is the unique solution in the displayed rectangle and depends continuously on E. Take all sites active, all partial potentials zero, and g = (H0 − E − tr)−1, where H0 is the free hopping matrix on TL. With h, K, F, D, X as in Section 2, one has gii = r, ∥K∥ ≤ 1/10, and max i X j |hij|4 ≤ 1 10t1+δ . The kernel of D is exactly the constants, and on neutral charges, X ≥ ct2 Λ+ , X ≥ cI, X ≤ C0I + Ct2 Λ+ , X ≤ (1 + tκ )p−2 I + CtΛ+ .
